description:
AWS Redis (ElastiCache for Valkey) registration data: the handles by which a
setup-created replication group is registered as a Frozen Redis resource. Setup owns
the group, Alien refreshes and heartbeats it. Carries the AUTH token's Secrets Manager
ARN, never the token.

authSecretArn.description: Secrets Manager ARN of the AUTH token (never the token itself).

highAvailability.description: Whether the group has a replica.

securityGroupId.description: Dedicated security group admitting 6379 from the workload security groups.
